pages.title: Edge-walkers
pages.text:
The Edge-walkers kept footholds past the last fence post — cuts in the Loom that led somewhere on purpose. Spiritgear was theirs: tools that spend Pulse instead of edge.

They left the footholds so nobody would have to be brave in the same place twice.

pages.title: Claw Strand
pages.text:
*Boots first. Then the bridge. Then the courage; it arrives on its own.*

Seated. The Edge-walkers answer when this Post hums.

pages.title: Their camp
pages.text:
The Edge-walkers keep a camp in the March highlands: huts, a fire, a Tribe Hearth, a Fire totem, a banner, four Kin — an Elder, a Drummer, a Hunter and a Weaver — and the same six-offer counter as before.

Their hearth favours leather, iron, Rift Fang. Their Elder trades Spiritgear and footholds. At Voice standing they press the tribe's Mark into your hand. Camps already generated in an old world keep the layout they spawned with.
